name: End Times raises range and halves mana cost for Blade of the Empire, Netherstrike and Hammer of Twilight (#3473)
contract: End Times 805115 (Spell.dbc, RecoveryTime 90000 = '1.5 min cooldown', DurationIndex 8 = 15000 ms = 'for 15 sec', family 31) has two spellmod aura effects: effect0 SPELLMOD_FLAT (107) on SPELLMOD_RANGE (misc 5), BasePoints 24+1=+25 yd; effect1 SPELLMOD_PCT (108) on SPELLMOD_COST (misc 14), BasePoints -51+1=-50%. Both SpellFamilyName 31 spells hit the family-31 routing override in SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod (SpellInfo.cpp:1503): 'case 805115: return root == 500720 || root == 806222 || root == 805116;' which bypasses the generic class-mask intersection entirely and instead matches by GetFirstSpellInChain(Id) against three named roots. DBC name lookup confirms all three are exactly the tooltip's three spells: 500720 = 'Blade of the Empire', 806222 = 'Netherstrike', 805116 = 'Hammer of Twilight'. This routing entry, and the whole mechanism, was already merged (commit e36bc50aa, 'Restore mechanics for five additional classes'); no further code change is needed. Both clauses are asserted with spell_modifier against an arbitrary base rather than spell_power_cost/an actual range check: Hammer of Twilight's own DBC ManaCostPercentage is 0, so a real-cost reading would be a 0/0 ratio for that spell, and no scenario metric reads effective range outside an active cast; spell_modifier (op 5 / op 14) reads the same native Player::ApplySpellMod path deterministically for all three regardless of their own base values. A control spell outside the routed roots (Dark Chants' own target, Forbidden Ritual 800105) must be unaffected. Regression guard for already-shipped native behaviour; no code change.
